answer_1.quote: LLMs are also prompted to generate explanations when verifying claims.

answer_3.quote: Therefore, we engage advanced LLMs (gpt-4o-2024-05-13 in practice) to evaluate the quality of explanations based on four metrics which widely employed in human evaluation : misleadingness (M), readability (R), soundness (S) and informativeness (I).

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we add a human evaluation to provide a comprehensive assessment of the explanations. We invited 10 volunteers (5 undergraduates and 5 graduates) to assess a random sample of 100 items in two dataset.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation metrics are identical to those used in the automatic evaluation
